observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white game console with 'PlayStation' logo, standing upright on a dark tufted sofa/ottoman against a wooden slat-panel wall.
One white DualSense-style controller is positioned in front of the console in both photos.
In photo 1, the edge of what appears to be a game disc case is visible leaning behind the console, but the console's disc slot or front face is not clearly shown.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or box is visible in either photo.
No photo of a UK receipt is provided.
No close-up of the ports (rear or side) is shown.
No photo or video showing the console powered on or booting.

claims.evidence: No internal or seal photo provided; cannot be judged from exterior shots alone.
Requires a power-on/running test, not shown in either photo.
No close-up of rear/side ports in photo 0 or 1.
Only one controller is visible in photo 0 and 1, matching the '1 pad' in the title, but 'pads' (plural) in the description is not shown.
No receipt image included in the two photos.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (overheating, disc drive issues).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on to the home screen and running a game or disc.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable) not shown in photos.
risks.proof: A photo laying out all included cables and accessories.

risks.risk: Disc vs digital edition unclear, which affects resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front of the console showing the disc slot (or its absence).

risks.risk: UK receipt claim cannot be confirmed, affecting authenticity/import status.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the receipt with date, model, and retailer visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified import, no warranty value added

risks.risk: Controller condition (stick drift, battery health) unknown.
risks.proof: A short video demonstrating analog stick movement and button response.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controller in unknown/worn condition

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading a game or the home screen.
Clear photo of the front of the console showing the disc slot or digital-edition face.
Photo of all included cables (power, HDMI) and the controller together.
Photo of the UK purchase receipt.
Close-up photo of the rear ports.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PlayStation 5 console with one controller, but none of the seller's functional or completeness claims are supported by the photos, so it must be priced at the worst case among comparable PS5 listings.
